provenance.semantics: ideal_real; split s of (q_abs, head g) is attention over the s-th selected KV block alone: O = exp2(softmax_scale_log2 q.k)-weighted mean of v over the block's visible tokens, partial_lse = ln(sum of the weights) (-inf if none), partial_scale = max|O|/448, partial_o = e4m3(O * 448 / max|O|); the block of (s, q_abs, h) is the CSR row of the head-h edge whose payload decodes to (s, q_abs)
